seven_slots.name: objects_and_spaces
seven_slots.detail: General Hausdorff X specialized to real line; f is constantly bottom in EReal; V is singleton zero. Both extended endpoints remain in codomain.

seven_slots.name: quantification
seven_slots.detail: Closed theorem with no public premise binders. Fixed f,V; existential feasible minimizer is produced. This is an instance, not a restatement of all A.3 instances.

seven_slots.name: assumptions
seven_slots.detail: Global lower semicontinuity, compactness and actual nonempty V intersection effectiveDomain occur as proved conclusions. Internal construction required later. Hausdorff real topology is standard. SourceProper is not assumed.

seven_slots.name: conclusion
seven_slots.detail: First conjunct asserts exists p in V with IsMinOn f V p. For bottom constant every feasible p minimizes; zero witnesses attainment at negative infinity. Other five conjuncts expose premises and improperness discriminator.

seven_slots.name: constants_normalization
seven_slots.detail: Zero selects singleton; bottom is negative infinity, never coerced to a finite real number. No rates or normalization.

seven_slots.name: probability_feedback
seven_slots.detail: Pure deterministic topological existence; no probability, filtration or stopping semantics.

seven_slots.name: boundary
seven_slots.detail: Source A.3 permits bottom and imposes no properness. effectiveDomain f={x|f x<top} includes bottom; SourceProper requires global no-bottom plus finite witness, so it fails here. Closed canary is deliberately narrower than full A.3 and proves no general theorem by itself.

mathematical_check: Constant maps are lower semicontinuous; singleton zero is compact and nonempty; bottom<top puts zero in effectiveDomain; bottom violates no-bottom at zero. Thus all six requested conjuncts are coherent and true mathematically.
